items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: I had no idea that there were that many people that would vote for somebody like that. I mean I knew they existed but I had no idea of the number.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well here’s not a softball question to sort of wrap up to. I’m interested in what artists have to think about the state of our country. So you could pass on the question but if you want to offer something I’d be happy to hear about it.

Sure. I think we’re in a very dark and dangerous point in our history right now with the anti-democratic, not just direction but I feel like we might even have a civil war because it just seems like what’s been happening with the Republican party and the fact that they still embrace Trump after everything, it’s just like they — are you a Republican?
